concerns.location: plan.md:Mapping of Functional Requirements (FR) & Success Criteria (SC) to Pipeline Phases & Data‑Model Entities table (lines ≈ 70‑120)
concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑009 (Data‑Model Entity Alignment) is not referenced anywhere in the plan. No phase, contract, or data‑model entity is explicitly linked to FR‑009, leaving this requirement unbacked.
The plan introduces a new CostMetric entity and a T004 integration test that are not part of the specification’s FR/SC list. This constitutes over‑reach beyond what the spec requires.
